definitions.gloss: reminder letter; demand notice; dunning letter
definitions.explanation: A written notice urging someone to fulfill an overdue obligation, such as paying a bill or returning a borrowed item. Firmer in tone than a simple reminder.

examples.japanese: {督促状|とくそくじょう}が{届|とど}いた。
{家賃|やちん}の{督促状|とくそくじょう}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
examples.english: I received a demand notice for overdue rent.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}から{返却|へんきゃく}の{督促状|とくそくじょう}が{送|おく}られてきた。
examples.english: The library sent a reminder to return the books.

notes:
Composed of {督促|とくそく} (urging, pressing) + {状|じょう} (letter, document). Sent when a deadline has already passed, so it carries more pressure than a friendly reminder.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {督促状|とくそくじょう}を{送|おく}る: to send a demand notice
- {支払|しはら}いの{督促状|とくそくじょう}: a payment demand notice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {催促|さいそく}: pressing for something — the act, spoken or written
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}: invoice, bill — the original demand for payment, not the overdue reminder
